stem: A Massachusetts pharmacy audits its ADD program. Which records or data should be retained as part of the ADD record system? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A verbal recollection from the charge nurse instead of a retrievable transaction record
Documentation of required approval for the ADD location
ADD transaction data showing product, patient identifier, date/time, and reconciliation
Records of ADD maintenance and personnel access/events
Retain retrievable ADD records for at least two years as required by the device policy.

explanation.core_reasoning: ADD records include approvals, device/event information, access, transaction details, and reconciliation rather than a single purchase record.

choice_analysis.A: Verbal recollection is not the required record.
choice_analysis.B: Approval documentation belongs in the record set.
choice_analysis.C: Transaction and reconciliation data are required.
choice_analysis.D: Maintenance and access events are tracked.
choice_analysis.E: The ADD policy requires retention of the device records for at least two years.

related_facts: The pharmacy maintains ADD records for at least two years under the policy.
explanation.mpje_trap: Substituting ordinary purchasing records for ADD accountability records.

reasoning_steps: Reject substitutes that omit device-event accountability
